<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Impenetrable Fog](/Feats.aspx?ID=4275) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 33

</column>

---

Fog condenses in a chaotic, swirling pattern, thick enough that it seems to push back against you. You call forth a fog bank in a 10-foot burst within 120 feet. All creatures in the fog are [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4), and all creatures outside the fog become concealed to creatures within it. The fog is so magically dense it impedes movement, making the area [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453). The fog lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute.

---
**Level (+3)** You can make the radius of the burst larger. Increase its maximum size by 5 feet.
name: Impenetrable Fog
